text_block_list.text:
I came out to have lunch with Matikanefukukitaru,
but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If I eat that 'Jiggly♪ Pudding',
will my skin get all 'jiggly♪' too, I wonder...?
choice_data_list: Doesn't look like it'll happen, huh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh~! Then what should I do about my skin that's as dry as paper talismans?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
According to feng shui,
rough skin brings total, absolute bad luck~~!!

Matikanefukukitaru seems to be troubled
by skin problems...
